text: No, there was no fire detected on the asset ASSET-F01 during the evaluated period from 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-23. The assessment status is "NOT_DETECTED," meaning no thermal anomalies were recorded by NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) sensors—VIIRS (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) or MODIS—within the asset boundary. While this confirms no major fires occurred, small or short-lived fires could have gone undetected, and the assessment does not confirm the absence of burned areas or identify the cause of any changes.
